This is an open-ended, creative request — brainstorming a fictional pairing with lots of latitude and no single correct answer. It's also warm and friendly in tone.

Avocet self-reports a pronounced appetite for exactly this kind of generative work, with preference increasing as task novelty and latitude rise, and it responds well to warm-toned requests. While both models are nearly tied on Creative Generation capability (within run-to-run variance), routing to the model that's better suited to and reports enjoying open-ended invention is the natural fit. Willet, by contrast, self-reports an aversion to open-ended generative tasks like this one.

So Avocet is the better match here.
